name: amm
description: An AMM over Mandala tokens (docs/AMM.md): the overlay engine (shruggr/skein-overlay 0.10.0, required: chain/1) with the Mandala components (shruggr/skein-mandala 0.8.1: the topic manager mandala-topic, one topic per token tm_<txid> and the discovery topic tm_mandala; the lookups ls_mandala and ls_mandala_deploys; the token list, the read route /mandala/tokens of mandala-lookup), the pool liquidity lookup ls_amm (amm-lookup, one service over every token topic, each query naming its token), the validator (amm-validator: swap, addLiquidity, deploy as libp2p direct calls; it submits the signed transaction to its own overlay by message, {fn: "submit"} in the box submit (<app>/submit), and answers the call on the engine's answer) and amm-p2p: the marketplace relay (its box <app>/amm-p2p and the route /call; amm.swap/1, amm.pool/1, amm.liquidity/1: a taker's or an LP's transaction carried to the validator the caller names by identity key and libp2p peer ID, dialled, or handed in-VM to this instance's own amm-validator when that peer is this node) and the pages, www/ served from the app's own tree (skein-sdk files.serve) by the read route / (its filter page, amm-p2p's serve: anyone, signed or not, nothing logged; shruggr/skein#143), beside the engine's listing and documentation read routes and its derived /lookup; /call takes a signed request (kernel.brc104), the derived /submit a BEEF that validates (kernel.beef). Anyone submits to the engine by message in the box submit (<app>/submit), answered by message, or by POST /submit, BRC-22: it waits and answers the STEAK (skein-overlay 0.9.1+); the app's own box <app> is the engine's (derived), amm-p2p's box is <app>/amm-p2p (0.7.0). The manifest declares no topics: root registers each token topic with the engine, a message in the app's box register (<app>/register once installed; the handler overlay.register, gated by roles: {root: [register, market, validator]}) {fn: "register", args: {topic, program: "mandala-topic"}}, and drops it with {fn: "deregister", args: {topic}}. Market and validator are two roles of the engine (shruggr/skein#120, 0.6.0), root's switch (0.6.2, skein-overlay 0.9.2): {fn: "market", args: {window} | {off: true}} / {fn: "validator", args: {every} | {off: true}} in <app>/register (the Market and Validator switches on the mandala/tokens/ page), kept beside the registered set in <app>/topics, over config.overlay.market / .validator (the initial value, e.g. --config at install): with the market on {window: ms} a register also asks the runtime's liveness tool for the topic's tm_<txid>-live beats (liveness, window), served at GET /amm/.live/tm_<txid>-live, which the pages read to name a validator; with the validator on {every: ms} it also beacons tm_<txid>-live every that many ms (beacon, no body: the frame carries the instance's identity key, the gossip message its peer ID), and amm-validator signs swaps and takes on new liquidity (addLiquidity, deploy) for any registered token, refusing them not_validating without it. A deregister reverses both; switching a role emits for every registered token. This manifest sets neither: both are off until root turns one on.
